query: User owes 200 USDC on their lending account and wants to pay it off with their XLM collateral in one transaction. How do I wire the swap in?
expected_behavior: Quotes with from = collateral token (XLM), to = debt token (USDC), amountIn = the collateral amount to withdraw (base-unit string), slippage set, and NO sender: sender only adds a standalone execute_strategy envelope and a server-side simulation of the wrong transaction; routeXdr is present whenever slippage is present

Passes the quote as steps: { routeXdr: quote.routeXdr } (or mapQuoteResponseToStrategySwap(quote)) to buildStellarRepayDebtWithCollateralTx with collateralAmount equal to the quoted amountIn and the existing accountNonce (never 0: this verb requires an existing account and reverts with AccountNotFound)
States that when collateral token === debt token the swap bytes must be empty (buildSameTokenRepaySwapSteps() / new Uint8Array(0)); any placeholder route reverts with GenericError::InvalidPayments

Re-simulates the composed controller transaction (prepareStellarBuiltTx / simulateTransaction) before signing instead of relying on the quote server's simulation, and explains that NoSwapOutput / RouterOverspend / SlippageExceeded are the revert paths to expect if the route went stale
machine_checkable: The quote request object for the composed path contains no 'sender' key and does contain 'slippage'
Quote from/to equal the collateral/debt assets passed to buildStellarRepayDebtWithCollateralTx and quote.amountIn === args.collateralAmount
Same-token branch passes a zero-length Uint8Array (or buildSameTokenRepaySwapSteps()) as steps
